faq: Does my data train public AI models?
We choose providers and settings that do not use your content to train public models where this is offered, and tell you which settings we used. You can review the terms of any provider yourself.
What file types can you use?
PDF, Word, Google Docs, web pages, spreadsheets and plain text. Scanned documents need reading first, which we can include if you ask.
How often does it learn new content?
On a schedule or when you add a file, depending on the package. New content is checked before it goes live, so one wrong file does not change every answer.
Can I remove something it learned?
Yes. Delete the file or entry from the source and it stops being used once the content refreshes. We show you how to do that in the handover notes.

desc:
To train a chatbot on your documents and products means connecting it to your own content so it answers from facts about your business. Ecom Swift LLC prepares your files, sets up the search behind the assistant and tests it with real questions.

## What does it mean to train a chatbot on your own data?

Training a chatbot on your data usually means giving it a library of your documents, product details and policies and setting it up to search that library before it answers. The assistant then builds its reply from what it finds, and can show which document the answer came from.

A general chatbot knows a lot about the world but nothing about your shipping rules, your price list or your internal procedures. Without your data, it either says it does not know or invents something that sounds right. Connecting your content is what makes the assistant useful for your business.

## Why general chatbots give wrong answers about your business

A general model fills gaps with plausible guesses. Ask it about your return window and it may describe a typical one, not yours. The reply reads well, so the customer believes it.

Using your own content changes this. The assistant searches your documents, finds the relevant passage and answers from it. When nothing relevant exists, a well-configured assistant says it does not know and offers a person, instead of improvising. Showing the source also lets customers and staff check the answer.

## How the quality of the data shapes the result

The assistant can only be as good as the material behind it. Old versions, scanned pages with unreadable text and files that contradict each other all weaken answers. Preparation is therefore a large part of the work: cleaning text, splitting long documents into sensible sections and labeling them so search finds the right one.

Privacy is a second concern. Business documents may include pricing, customer details or internal notes. We keep your content in your own account and choose settings that keep it out of public model training where the provider allows that. Each provider has its own terms, so we explain what applies in your case.

## What a well-grounded assistant includes

- Your documents, pages and product data prepared as clean text.
- Content split into sections that search can match to a question.
- Answers that name the source document, and its date where available.
- A clear reply when the content has no answer.
- Topics the assistant must refuse, such as legal or medical advice.
- Product data or spreadsheets included for prices and specifications.
- A scheduled refresh, so changed content reaches the assistant.
- Testing on real questions with scored results.
- Optional buttons for customers to mark an answer helpful or not.
- A short guide to adding and removing content later.

## What we do

We collect the files you want the assistant to use and sort out what is current. Then we prepare them: converting formats, cleaning text and splitting it into searchable pieces. We set up the search layer and connect it to the assistant, with instructions that tell it to answer from the content and to say so when it cannot.

The Basic package covers a single set of documents with source citations. The Standard package adds more sources, product data, refusal rules and an honest "I don't know" reply. The Premium package covers a larger library, scheduled refreshes, dates on each answer, a quality score from the test run and a guide for adding content.

Scanned documents may need an extra reading step, and some file types work better than others. We tell you early if a file will not give good results.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Remove outdated versions before upload.
- Keep one current copy of every policy.
- Tell us what must never be shared with customers.
- Test with questions your customers really ask.
- Plan how new content will be added.

**Avoid:**
- Uploading private files that the assistant does not need.
- Mixing internal notes with public policies.
- Assuming the bot knows something that is not in your content.
- Leaving old price lists in the library.
- Skipping tests because the first few answers looked good.

## Who this service is for

It suits a business with a large catalog or many policy documents that staff struggle to search. It suits a firm whose team spends time answering questions found in existing manuals. It also suits a store that wants product questions answered from its real specification sheet.

## What we need from you

Send the documents, pages or spreadsheets you want used, and tell us which are the most important. Say what the assistant must not talk about. We need access to the chatbot or hosting account as a team member or developer user. Please never share passwords, and send files through a normal secure link.
